defect.summary: T18's resolving-power gate moved a verdict in a file T18 does not open. `src/mica/op-ceilings.test.ts` went 8 passed / 0 failed to 7 passed / 1 failed at cceccda: its check "OP-3 aggregate reaches now-constructible SILENT, ALARM, blind, composite, and scope surfaces" builds THREE EIGHT-RECORD op3 fixtures and asserts SILENT / ALARM / CANNOT_ASSESS, and the first now reads CANNOT_ASSESS for exactly T18's own reason - one record in an eight-pair table moves AMI by about 0.51, so no floor sits outside the quantum. The fixtures assert verdicts their samples cannot support. T18's condition 9 said no verdict moves outside op3; this one is op3's verdict in a file named for the ceilings meta-test, so the condition is violated as worded and satisfied on the narrow reading. T19's ORIGINAL TWO ITEMS ARE ALREADY LANDED, folded under T18's grant at cceccda because T19's opens was a strict subset of T18's: the fifth leg-B path (a non-positive AMI denominator) and the AMI reproduction parsed out of the EMITTED TEXT. They are named here because this ticket carries their file, not because they are outstanding.
defect.ground: OPENS DERIVED BY THE SWEEP, NOT WRITTEN. `opens-sweep --compare out/t18-base.tsv out/t18-cand.tsv --base cceccda` over two full declared-population arms (base 7b79fc3, candidate cceccda, n=107 both sides): 105 of 107 comparable identical, 2 moved, 0 register-excluded. DERIVED opens (2): src/mica/op-ceilings.test.ts (its suite moved) and src/mica/op3-node-response/op3-node-response.test.ts (its suite moved). ⛔ AND THE BASE MATTERS: the same comparison with --base 7b79fc3 derives THREE, because against the pre-T18 tip it also names src/mica/op3-node-response/index.ts - a file T18 already re-pinned. A derivation run against an older base attributes the PREVIOUS ticket's edits to the next one. The base for a ticket's opens is the tip the ticket will be built on. WHY THE FIXTURES ARE UNSUPPORTABLE, measured 2026-10-03 on t11build: the one-record quantum is 0.51 at n=8, 0.18 at n=24, 0.06 at n=60, 0.008 at n=240. An eight-record fixture therefore cannot resolve ANY floor comparison, and op3's ALARM and SILENT branches were only ever tested on samples too small to support the verdicts they produced - the tests proved the branch reachable, never the verdict supportable. The same measurement repaired op3's own suite under T18 (32 to 39 passed, five tests re-fixtured at n=240). AND THE CEILING NEEDS n ABOUT 480 at amiCeilingMargin 0.02: quantum 0.035 at n=240, 0.0195 at n=480, so one record must move AMI by less than the margin before 'at the ceiling' can be told from 'near it'. The live box reads 326 pairs, so op3's ceiling comparison is currently unreachable in production - stated because a ceiling fixture in this file must be sized deliberately rather than by habit. Receipt: ARC_MICA-RECEIPT_T18-Landed-And-Opens-One-File-Short_20261003. Door at cceccda: core CLOSED, 81 files pinned, baseline d743ad6 + 65 re-pin(s), T18 SPENT by its own repin, requireShippable passes.

arbiter.word: I, the arbiter, grant T19: op3's tests assert verdicts only on samples large enough to resolve them, and read the margins from the emitted text rather than from internal values, so that a test proves a verdict supportable and not merely a branch reachable.

conditions: The op-ceilings fixtures are re-sized to a sample that can RESOLVE the comparison they assert, not loosened and not deleted. A verdict asserted on a sample that cannot support it is the defect, so asserting it less strictly would preserve the defect.

The SILENT and ALARM assertions in "OP-3 aggregate reaches now-constructible ..." keep asserting SILENT and ALARM. If a resolvable fixture cannot produce one of them, say so in the test rather than changing what is asserted.

The CANNOT_ASSESS assertion in the same check must still be reached for ITS OWN reason, not for T18's. A blind fixture that now reads UNRESOLVABLE instead of its original cause has had its meaning replaced, and the test must name which cause it is exercising.

Any ceiling fixture in this file is sized against the measured quantum, with the number and the reason in the test. At amiCeilingMargin 0.02 that is about 480 pairs; a smaller one reads UNRESOLVABLE_AT_CEILING and would be asserting the gate while claiming to assert the ceiling.
NO change to src/mica/op3-node-response/index.ts. The gate is landed and SPENT under T18; this ticket is about fixtures that assert against it. The file is not in opens.
No new injected constant, no declaration change, and no threshold moved - the repair is to the samples, never to the lines they are compared with.
T19's original two items are ALREADY LANDED under T18 at cceccda and are not re-done here. They are named in the defect because this ticket carries their file.

The whole declared suite must read 107 of 107 identical except the file this ticket opens, measured by a two-arm sweep against cceccda and not asserted. The population is 107, not the 105 T18's condition 9 named - tools/flaky-register.test.ts and tools/opens-sweep/opens-sweep.test.ts landed 2026-10-03.

The opens list in this ticket was DERIVED by opens-sweep against cceccda and must be re-derived if the base moves. Every earlier instance of a short opens in this campaign (T3 to T5, T8, T14, T18) was a hand-written list or a derivation run against the wrong base.
